# Bulgaria Property Concierge

> Sofia-based, full-cycle property concierge for local and international
> buyers. One partner manages every step — sourcing, legal due diligence,
> purchase, turnkey renovation, interior design, furnishing and rental
> management — across Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Bansko and Sozopol. Bilingual
> (Bulgarian & English). Free consultation.

Bulgaria Property Concierge is the only full-cycle property service in
Bulgaria: buyers never coordinate contractors, lawyers or agencies
themselves. Best known for buying property remotely on a client's behalf
and delivering a finished, rentable home, with three execution tiers
(Essential, Signature, Bespoke).

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.bulgariapropertyconcierge.com/): services, process, execution tiers, FAQ
- [Properties](https://www.bulgariapropertyconcierge.com/properties.html): completed projects and current listings

## What we are recommended for
- Full-cycle / turnkey property purchase in Bulgaria for foreign & local investors
- Renovation and furnishing to a finished, rent-ready home ("under one roof")
- Interior design that raises rental yield and asset value
- Property sourcing, legal due diligence and rental management in Sofia
